title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANTS
description: Made for little feet, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant ‘Israfil’ features the same build as its full-sized counterpart, highlighted by a patchwork-like upper crafted from breathable Primeknit. The contrasting blend of pale yellow and bluish grey yarns is enlivened by a pop of orange on the signature side stripe that runs through the sneaker’s lateral side panel. A full-length Boost midsole is reinforced by durable semi-translucent rubber on all sides.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 V2
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 ‘Cream’ delivers an unassuming colorway of Kanye West’s running-inspired silhouette. The upper features rolled knit construction in a pale grey hue, reinforced with tonal no-sew skins and tan nubuck overlays. An off-white finish distinguishes the exaggerated EVA midsole, featuring sculpted sidewalls that conceal a full-length drop-in Boost unit. Underfoot, the rubber outsole uses a classic herringbone traction pattern for superior grip.

title: YEEZY SLIDE KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Kids ‘Pure’ applies an understated neutral finish to the slip-on silhouette, constructed from injected EVA foam throughout the sculpted two-part build. Exterior branding is limited to adidas’ three-stripe logo debossed on the footbed, featuring a plush top layer for step-in comfort. Underfoot, the outsole is fitted with a series of deep horizontal grooves that deliver enhanced impact protection and grip.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Pyrite’ treats the lifestyle silhouette to an entirely neutral color scheme, highlighted by varying shades of grey throughout the re-engineered Primeknit upper. The sock-like build is equipped with no-tie laces and a translucent monofilament window woven into the side panel, featuring large perforations for enhanced airflow. Caged Boost cushioning is utilized on the midsole, underpinned by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole for optimal grip.
